spec: §9.2: "Semantic envelope ... every part ends with LF"; "Reference replacement"; "member hash = SHA-256 ... <scc_hash hex>:<decimal index>"
derivation: Hashes independently assembled with Python hashlib from isa=0.8 LF, ptr_width=32 LF, JCS signature LF, canonical function lines LF, and each referenced callee hash LF (§9.2); definitions retain their own name, call references use callee hashes. rsum is a self-recursive SCC: replace call @rsum by @$0; hash the envelope, then hash ASCII scc_hex + :0.
